data.pricing: Four plans billed annually: Basic at $16/month ($25/month if billed monthly), Core at $23/month ($36/month monthly), Plus at $39/month ($56/month monthly), and Advanced at $99/month ($139/month monthly). Annual billing saves approximately 30% and includes a free custom domain for the first year.
key_features: AI-powered website builder with templates and drag-and-drop editing
Built-in SEO tools with AI-generated titles, descriptions, and alt text
Fully integrated e-commerce with unlimited products (features vary by plan)
Unlimited bandwidth and storage on all plans
Built-in analytics, payment processing (Squarespace Payments), and mobile app management
limitations: Limited deep customization - templates restrict significant layout and functionality changes beyond basic elements
No phone support available - support is limited to email and chat only
data.notable_limits: Basic plan: limited to 2 contributors, no custom code access, 3% transaction fee on sales. Core plan: 0% transaction fee on physical products but 1% on digital content. Transaction fees eliminated only on Plus and Advanced plans. No advanced keyword research tools for SEO. Limited third-party integrations compared to competitors.

data.pricing: Elementor Pro pricing starts at $49/year (per official site) with multiple tiers: Essential ($59/year for 1 site), Advanced Solo ($79-84/year for 1 site with eCommerce), Advanced ($99/year for 3 sites), Expert ($199/year for 25 sites), and Agency ($399/year for 1,000 sites). All plans are annual subscriptions only—no monthly billing. There's also Elementor One bundle at $228/year ($168 first year) that includes Pro plus AI credits and additional tools.
key_features: Drag-and-drop visual page builder with 40+ widgets in free version, 85+ widgets in Pro, plus 100+ pre-built templates and website kits
Theme Builder for creating custom headers, footers, and archive templates (Pro only)
WooCommerce Builder with custom product pages, cart, and checkout design capabilities (Pro only)
Popup Builder and Form Builder with CRM integrations and conditional logic (Pro only)
AI-powered features including Elementor AI for text, image, and code generation (available with trial credits, then $3.99/month or included in One plan)
limitations: Cannot edit on mobile phones or tablets—editing only available on desktop computers
Can cause performance issues and slower page load times due to extra code and DOM size, potentially affecting SEO rankings
Limited built-in SEO tools—requires additional plugins like Yoast or Rank Math for comprehensive optimization
Difficult migration away from Elementor due to proprietary shortcodes and content structures—content is not easily portable to other platforms
data.notable_limits: Free version permanently available but lacks Theme Builder, Popup Builder, WooCommerce integration, custom CSS, and advanced widgets. Pro plans limited by number of site activations (1, 3, 25, or 1,000 sites depending on tier). Elementor One includes shared monthly credit pool for AI, image optimization, and email deliverability. 30-day money-back guarantee for annual plans (not a traditional free trial).

data.pricing: Free Plan: $0 (basic CRM, 2,000 email sends/month, live chat, unlimited contacts). Starter: $15-20/seat/month (includes 1,000 marketing contacts, available month-to-month or annual). Professional: $890/month (includes 3 seats, 2,000 marketing contacts) plus mandatory $3,000 onboarding fee. Enterprise: $3,600/month (includes 5 seats, 10,000 marketing contacts) plus $7,000 onboarding fee. Additional contacts cost extra at all paid tiers. Sales Hub Professional starts at $100/seat/month, Service Hub follows similar tiered structure.
key_features: All-in-one CRM platform with unified contact management, deal tracking, and email integration across marketing, sales, and service hubs
Marketing automation including email marketing, landing pages, forms, workflows, lead scoring, and campaign management (Professional tier and above)
AI-powered features via Breeze including customer agents, prospecting agents, content creation, and data enrichment (usage-based credits included with paid plans)
Comprehensive reporting and analytics with customizable dashboards, funnel analytics, and attribution data (advanced features in Professional/Enterprise)
Extensive integrations with 1,500+ third-party apps and HubSpot Academy for free training and certifications
limitations: No workflow automation or advanced marketing features on Free or Starter plans - sequences, A/B testing, custom reporting, and smart content require Professional tier ($890/month minimum)
Free plan lacks role-based permissions and access controls, has 2,000 monthly email limit for entire account, HubSpot branding on all communications, and no custom reporting or forecasting
data.notable_limits: Marketing Hub pricing based on marketing contacts (not total contacts) - Professional includes 2,000 contacts, additional 5,000 costs ~$224/month. Professional and Enterprise require annual commitment. Professional plans include minimum 3 seats, Enterprise includes 5 seats. Advanced AI features and deeper automation locked behind Professional/Enterprise tiers. Monthly HubSpot Credits allotted per plan (500 on Starter, 3,000-5,000 on Professional, up to 10,000 on Enterprise) for AI and data features.

data.pricing: Pipedrive offers 4 plans: Lite at $14/user/month, Growth at $39/user/month, Premium at $49/user/month, and Ultimate at $79/user/month (all billed annually). Monthly billing is higher at $24, $49, $79, and $99 respectively.
key_features: Visual pipeline management with drag-and-drop interface for tracking deals through custom sales stages
Two-way email sync with templates and tracking, integrated directly with Gmail and other email providers
Workflow automations and AI-powered features including automated activities, deal routing, and sales tips
Over 400-500 integrations with tools like Google Workspace, Slack, QuickBooks, and Zapier
Customizable pipelines, fields, and activity types with mobile CRM apps for on-the-go deal management
limitations: Does not include native multichannel prospecting or lead generation - focused on managing relationships rather than creating them, requiring paid add-ons like LeadBooster for lead capture

Limited marketing automation capabilities - email marketing (Campaigns) and website tracking (Web Visitors) are paid add-ons on all plans, not suitable for marketing-heavy organizations compared to HubSpot or ActiveCampaign
data.notable_limits: Automation workflows have a 90-day maximum duration, making them unsuitable for long sales cycles or lifecycle automation. No permanent free plan available, only a 14-day free trial with no credit card required. Essential add-ons like LeadBooster ($32.50/company/month), Web Visitors ($49/month), and Campaigns ($16/month) significantly increase total cost beyond base pricing.

data.pricing: Solo at $9/user/month, Essentials at $35/user/month, Growth at $99/user/month, and Scale at $139/user/month (annual billing). Monthly billing adds 25-35% to each plan.
key_features: Built-in Power Dialer with VoIP calling, call recording, and automatic call logging directly in the CRM
Chloe AI sales agent that calls leads, qualifies prospects through conversations, and books meetings automatically
Integrated email, SMS, and calling in a single platform with pipeline management and workflow automation (Growth plan and above)
Two-way email sync, bulk email sequences, and task management with Smart Views for lead segmentation
Native web forms builder (Close Forms) to capture and route website leads directly into the CRM
limitations: No built-in prospecting data, contact database, or buyer intent signals - requires external data sources or enrichment tools
No marketing automation, no native LinkedIn integration, limited customization (cannot create custom objects, only custom fields), and SMS limited to US, Canada, GB, and Australia only
data.notable_limits: Solo plan limited to 1 user and 10,000 leads. Call recording retention is 30-90 days on lower plans (unlimited only on Scale). Calling and SMS usage billed separately as variable costs. No free forever plan available.

data.pricing: Starter: $9/user/month (annual) or $12/user/month (monthly), max 3 users; Basic: $23/user/month (annual) or $29/user/month (monthly); Professional: $59/user/month (annual) or $69/user/month (monthly); Business: $99/user/month (annual) or $134/user/month (monthly)
key_features: Deep Google Workspace integration with Chrome extension that embeds CRM directly in Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Drive
Automated contact and email capture from Gmail with automatic data enrichment from social networks and web sources
Visual drag-and-drop sales pipeline management with workflow automation and AI-driven deal alerts
Customizable fields, reports, and email templates with workflow triggers for automated follow-ups and task assignments
Mobile access across iOS and Android with 100+ integrations including Slack, Mailchimp, DocuSign, QuickBooks, and Zapier
limitations: Only works with Gmail and Google Workspace - not suitable for teams using Office 365, Yahoo, or other email providers
No free plan available, lacks inventory management and incident management capabilities, and advanced features like custom reports are restricted to the Business plan only
data.notable_limits: Basic plan limited to 3 users and 2,500 contacts; Professional plan limited to 15,000 contacts; Starter plan lacks customizable pipelines, reporting capabilities, and advanced integrations; contact limits and feature-gating increase costs as teams scale

data.pricing: Single plan at $249/month billed annually (or $299/month billed monthly). Includes 2 users and 1,500 contacts. Additional users cost $39/month each. Additional contacts charged in tiers. Mandatory $500 onboarding fee for new customers. 14-day free trial available.
key_features: All-in-one CRM with advanced marketing automation, sales pipeline, email marketing, and AI-powered workflow builder
Integrated payment processing, invoicing, and appointment scheduling built directly into the platform
Visual drag-and-drop automation builder with if-then branching logic for sophisticated multi-path sequences
Built-in business phone line and SMS marketing with text automation capabilities
Landing pages, lead capture forms, contact tagging and segmentation with comprehensive contact management
limitations: Steep learning curve and can be overcomplicated for very small lists or simple needs
Limited native two-way SMS automation and no ringless voicemail drops; automation is primarily email-centric rather than true multi-channel
data.notable_limits: Free trial has 25-email sending limit, no payment processing, and no SMS capability. Contact-based pricing scales up quickly as list grows. Additional users at $39/month each beyond the included 2 users. Mandatory $500 onboarding fee applies to all new accounts.

data.pricing: Free plan: up to 250 subscribers, 2,500 emails/month. Comfort plan: starts at $12/month for 500 subscribers with 10x subscriber limit on monthly emails (5,000 emails for 500 subscribers). Power plan: starts at $25/month for 500 subscribers with unlimited monthly emails. Enterprise: custom pricing for 200,000+ subscribers. 10% discount on annual billing. 14-day free trial of paid features available.
key_features: Drag-and-drop email builder with 100+ templates and all three email editors (drag-and-drop, custom HTML, simple)
Marketing automation with visual workflow builder, multi-trigger automations on higher plans
Landing pages and website builder with hosting included
AI writing assistant for email content and subject lines (Comfort plan and above)
Digital product sales and paid newsletter subscriptions with 0% commission
limitations: Does not include transactional emails - requires separate MailerSend product starting at $7/month for 5,000 emails
Free plan limited to 3 automations, 3 forms, 1 landing page, 1 website, and includes MailerLite branding on emails
data.notable_limits: Comfort plan has 3 user seats and caps monthly sends at 10x your subscriber count. Power plan offers unlimited users, unlimited sends, and unlimited landing pages/websites. Free plan subscriber limit was recently reduced from 500 to 250 (June 2026) and email sends reduced from 12,000 to 2,500/month.

data.pricing: Free plan at $0/month with 1 hour media/month and 100 AI credits. Hobbyist plan at $16/month (annual) or $24/month (monthly) with 10 hours media/month. Creator plan at $24/month (annual) or $35/month (monthly) with 30 hours media/month. Business plan at $50/month (annual) or $65/month (monthly) with 40 hours media/month. Enterprise plan with custom pricing.
key_features: Text-based video and audio editing - edit media by editing the transcript, with AI transcription in 25 languages
Studio Sound - AI-powered audio enhancement that removes background noise and improves recording quality
AI features including filler word removal, automated captions, eye contact correction, and AI voice cloning (Overdub)
Multitrack editing with speaker detection and labeling for podcasts and interviews
Built-in screen recording, remote recording, and collaboration tools with royalty-free stock media library
limitations: Not a replacement for professional video editors like Adobe Premiere or Final Cut Pro - lacks advanced color grading, motion graphics, and detailed codec/export controls
No mobile app for editing on the go - desktop only
data.notable_limits: Free plan: 1 hour media/month, 720p export with watermark (1 watermark-free export/month), 100 AI credits one-time, 5GB storage. Media hours track all uploaded/recorded media and do not roll over monthly. AI credits track usage of AI features. Plan limits vary by tier with transcription accuracy issues reported for non-American/British accents. Performance can slow on larger projects with heavy edits.

data.pricing: Pro plan: $69/month (monthly billing) or $59/month (annual billing) per seat with unlimited AI-generated words. Business plan: Custom pricing (contact sales). Annual billing saves approximately 20%.
key_features: Unlimited AI-generated words on all plans with seat-based pricing model
Brand Voice customization - Pro includes 2 Brand Voices, Business offers unlimited
50+ marketing templates for blogs, ads, emails, social media, and product descriptions
Jasper IQ knowledge base integration to ground AI in company-specific facts and reduce hallucinations
Content Pipelines and AI Agents for automating campaign-scale content workflows (Business plan)
limitations: Does not include native SEO capabilities - no keyword research, SERP analysis, or rank tracking (requires separate tools like Surfer SEO)
Long-form content requires significant human editing to avoid formulaic AI tone and fact-checking for accuracy
data.notable_limits: Pro plan limited to 1 user seat (additional seats require Business plan), 2 Brand Voices, 5 Knowledge assets, and 3 Audiences. No permanent free plan available.

data.pricing: Pro plan: $9 per user/month (billed annually, 1-10 users). Business plan: $19 per user/month (billed annually, minimum 3 users). Enterprise plan: Custom pricing (minimum 10 users). Advanced Work Management plan: Custom pricing. Monthly billing available at approximately 25% higher rates.
key_features: Multiple work views including Gantt charts, Calendar, Grid, Board, and Card views for flexible project visualization
AI-powered features including Smart Assist for natural language queries, Smart Columns for automated sentiment analysis and translation, and AI dashboard builder
Unlimited automations on Business plan and above with 250 automations per month on Pro plan for workflow efficiency
Real-time collaboration with unlimited free viewers on Pro plan and unlimited free guests on Business/Enterprise plans
Extensive integrations with 100+ tools including Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Slack, Salesforce, and JIRA
limitations: No permanent free plan available (discontinued in 2025); only offers a 30-day free trial with no credit card required
Sheet capacity limits: 20,000 rows, 400 columns, and 500,000 cells maximum per sheet which can cause performance issues with large datasets and lack of true relational database functionality
data.notable_limits: Pro plan limited to 10 licensed users maximum. Business plan requires minimum 3 users. Enterprise requires minimum 10 users. Pro plan includes 250 automations/month and 20 GB storage. Premium add-ons (Dynamic View, Control Center, Data Shuttle, Bridge, WorkApps) cost extra and can add 20-50% to total contract value.

data.pricing: Free: $0 (unlimited pages and blocks for individuals). Plus: $10/user/month billed annually or $12/month billed monthly (unlimited file uploads, 30-day version history, unlimited guests). Business: $20/user/month billed annually or $24/month billed monthly (includes full Notion AI with Agents, AI Meeting Notes, SSO, advanced permissions). Enterprise: Custom pricing (SCIM provisioning, audit logs, unlimited version history, advanced security, dedicated support).
key_features: All-in-one workspace combining docs, wikis, projects, and databases with unlimited pages and blocks
Notion AI Agents that automate workflows and tasks across your workspace (Business plan and up)
Cross-platform search across Notion, Slack, Google Drive, GitHub and more integrated tools
Flexible database views (boards, timelines, calendars, tables) with relational properties and filters
Real-time collaboration with version history, page analytics, and team permissions
limitations: Does not manage email or calendar natively - no inbox management or scheduling features built-in
Cannot connect to live external systems for real-time data - AI works only with data already inside Notion workspace
data.notable_limits: Free plan: 5MB file upload limit, 7-day page history, 10 guest maximum. Plus/Free plans get only 20 AI trial responses (one-time). Business and Enterprise require Notion credits as add-on for Custom Agents/Workers automation. Annual billing saves ~17-20% vs monthly.
